current_margin_meta.formula: Q2 FY2027 FCF 377.4M / revenue 1.470897B = 25.6578%. Source: 2026-07-31 | SEC Exhibit 99.1.

terminal_margin_Y5.rationale: Cash margin can expand with subscription scale but the range explicitly retains SBC dilution and M&A/integration burden as risks rather than value adjustments. v1.0.1 widens tails for SBC/M&A integration drag and scaled-platform cash-conversion upside; mode 28% unchanged.

terminal_margin_Y8.rationale: Long-run upside is capped below an unconstrained software case; acquisitions must earn their economics rather than being treated as automatic margin accretion. v1.0.1 widens long-run tails while keeping the 30% center unchanged.

shock_sigma_meta.rationale: Quarterly company-specific cash-margin noise, separate from Joint Layer drivers.

shock_persistence_meta.rationale: Operating and working-capital shocks persist across adjacent quarters but mean-revert.

lower_bound_meta.rationale: Severe operating downside bound; discrete thesis breaks remain failure/recalibration events. v1.0.1 lowers the hard clipping floor so the widened downside terminal-margin tail is not mechanically truncated.

upper_bound_meta.rationale: Caps extrapolation beyond economically plausible mature cash conversion. v1.0.1 raises the clipping ceiling only to preserve the widened upside tail; no central margin assumption changes.

multiple.rationale: Near-term recurring growth can support a premium, with broad downside for duration compression. v1.0.1 widens duration-compression and premium-platform tails; mode 32x unchanged.

scenario_persistence_override.innovation_formula: eta_d,t = standardize(sum(lambda_d,r * u_r,t) + w_d * epsilon_d,t), with u_r,t root innovations after the current phase root-correlation state and epsilon_d,t the same driver idiosyncratic innovation used by BASE
scenario_persistence_override.initialization: when override begins, y_d,t-1 equals the last emitted standardized driver shock; do not initialize to zero
scenario_persistence_override.ramp_rule: numeric-to-numeric rho is linearly interpolated by phase weight; null is bypass and is not interpreted as rho=0
scenario_persistence_override.validation_rule: on a constant-rho plateau after warm-up, Var(y) must remain approximately 1 and empirical lag-1 correlation must approximate rho; insufficient plateau length is diagnostic, not failure

driver_generation.explicit_idiosyncratic_rule: These taxonomy drivers intentionally have no root mapping in v1.1. They retain independent standardized driver innovations; scenario mean/volatility overrides may still apply if a scenario explicitly names them. No root covariance is implied until a future normative reissue adds a mapping.
